body:
The user-approved key-prefix regression controls now live in ordinary library tests, on two personal test-only branches:

- **5bb5e5bd92d9127f287970eeb2493669e763e5cd**, `test/sam-key-independent-controls`, on held-stagecd2880f1.
- **4f9b6bb34fc0854f11c17ab218a11cba9eb1ca76**, `test/sam-key-independent-controls-main`, directly on main-repair71154c1d, so adoption need not wait for independent-key kernels.

[Tests, exact sources, raw runs, rejecting controls and bounded release-code review](https://github.com/samshackleton-tech/bench-hashes/blob/8b93915f43674e4e651763d82e5e0221bed7c16b/process/fast-feedback/ring-closure/r88/followup-2316/SECURITY-REVIEW.md).

`src/each.rs::held_dispatch_ignores_key_equality_and_prefixes` compares actual cohort membership/order, existing kernel-entry sets and pass counts. `tests/allocations.rs::held_allocations_ignore_key_equality_and_prefixes` compares calling-thread requested bytes and allocation requests in the normal non-test library. Constructors/key preparation/caller capacity stay outside counters; a4096B positive control checks the meter.

Keep public input shape fixed; use equal keys or distinct keys matching exactly0..7leading words. Counts3/8/16/17/33, keyed/fixed-mixed modes, two stages (zero/nonzero counters), all locally supported platforms, official digests. Existing600-hasher controls remain. Cohort observations are cfg(test) only; production hashing is unchanged.

Held-stage: Ice **233 release/21docs**, ARM VM **205/21**. Main child: **187/20**, **167/20**. Fmt/no-default/rustdoc pass. Planted equal-key grouping is rejected on SSE4.1/NEON; a separate AVX-512 control has identical memberships/pass counts but different kernel entries and is rejected too. A planted key-dependent allocation is rejected at **+64B/+2requests** over two stages. Each fault is restored byte-for-byte and positives rerun. No serialization or timing thresholds.

Captured release assembly/IR for5bb5e5bd supports the bounded selector review: public flags/platform/shape control dispatch; keys are copied into compression inputs. This is **not** an instruction-level or whole-library constant-time proof. Entry sets do not count every invocation, and a comparison with an unused result could escape these tests; source/generated-code review remains necessary.

71154c1d's direct main-source costs are posted on #318: plain Level, shared-key up to+8.9%Ice/+15.5%EPYC, requiring exact-source cost review. Those are not the independent-key candidate's measurements. No merge/release by me.

— Sam Shackleton
